formula: kwh = intercept + day_sin*sin(2*pi*doy/365.25) + day_cos*cos(2*pi*doy/365.25) + kwh_m2*x + kwh_m2_x_tmean*x*tmean

inputs.doy: day of year of the target date (Jan 1 = 1)
inputs.x: ECMWF daily shortwave radiation sum (kWh/m2, 00-23h KST)
inputs.tmean: ECMWF daily mean 2 m temperature (degC, mean of 24 hourly values 00-23h KST)

trained_with: Orange linear regression, 2025-09-26 ~ 2026-10-23, ECMWF Previous Runs lead 1/2/3
